translations.idiomatic: They honor him as recommender-patron and take the status of pupils upon themselves; gifts in baskets and cases continue for a lifetime without cease.

sentences.zh: 假明揚之典，開賄賂之門，無惑乎清白之吏不概見於天下也。

translations.literal: Under the pretext of the statute for open recommendation, they open the door to bribery—little wonder that uncorrupt officials are not seen everywhere under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Under the pretext of the statute for open recommendation, they open the door to bribery—little wonder that uncorrupt officials are not seen everywhere under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 方今國與民俱貧，而官獨富。

translations.literal: At present both the state and the people are poor, while officials alone are rich.
translations.idiomatic: At present both the state and the people are poor, while officials alone are rich.

sentences.zh: 既以官而得富，還以富而市官。

translations.literal: Having grown rich through office, they then use their riches to buy office.
translations.idiomatic: Having grown rich through office, they then use their riches to buy office.

sentences.zh: 此餽遺之積弊，八也。

translations.literal: This is the eighth longstanding abuse of gift-giving.
translations.idiomatic: This is the eighth entrenched abuse: gift-giving.

sentences.zh: 要此八者，敗壞之源不在於外，從而轉移亦不在於下也。

translations.literal: In sum, these eight are sources of ruin that lie not outside but within, and their shifting downward does not begin below.
translations.idiomatic: In sum, these eight are sources of ruin that lie not outside but within, and their shifting downward does not begin below.

sentences.zh: 昔齊威王烹一阿大夫，封一即墨大夫，而齊國大治。

translations.literal: Formerly King Wei of Qi executed one Lord of A and enfeoffed one Lord of Jimo, and the state of Qi was greatly well governed.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly King Wei of Qi executed one Lord of A and enfeoffed one Lord of Jimo, and the state of Qi was greatly well governed.

sentences.zh: 陛下誠大奮乾剛，痛懲吏弊，則風行草偃，天下可立治矣。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty will truly exert imperial vigor and severely punish official corruption, then the wind will blow and the grass will bend; all under Heaven can quickly be brought to order.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty will truly exert imperial vigor and severely punish official corruption, then the wind will blow and the grass will bend—all under Heaven can quickly be brought to order.

sentences.zh: 疏奏，帝稱善。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted, and the Emperor praised it.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted, and the Emperor praised it.

sentences.zh: 敕所司下撫按奉行，不如詔者罪。

translations.literal: He ordered the relevant offices to transmit it to the provincial governors and surveillance commissioners for enforcement; failure to comply with the edict would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the relevant offices to transmit it to the provincial governors and surveillance commissioners for enforcement; failure to comply with the edict would be punished.

sentences.zh: 頃之，言：「故給事中魏時亮、周世選，御史張檟、李復聘以忤高拱見黜，文選郎胡汝桂以忤尚書被傾，宜賜甄錄。

translations.literal: Before long, he memorialized: "The late Supervising Secretary Wei Shiliang and Zhou Shixuan, and the Censors Zhang Jiao and Li Fupin, were dismissed for offending Gao Gong; the Director of Personnel Hu Rugui was ruined for offending the Minister. They should be granted restored appointment and recognition.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, he memorialized: "The late Supervising Secretary Wei Shiliang and Zhou Shixuan, and the Censors Zhang Jiao and Li Fupin, were dismissed for offending Gao Gong; the Director of Personnel Hu Rugui was ruined for offending the Minister. They should be granted restored appointment and recognition.

sentences.zh: 御史于應昌構陷劉台與王宗載同罪，宗載遺戍而應昌止罷官。

translations.literal: The Censor Yu Yingchang fabricated charges against Liu Tai together with Wang Zongzai on the same offense; Zongzai was banished beyond the frontier while Yingchang was only dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: The Censor Yu Yingchang fabricated charges against Liu Tai together with Wang Zongzai on the same offense; Zongzai was banished beyond the frontier while Yingchang was only dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 勞堪巡撫福建，殺侍郎洪朝選。

translations.literal: Lao Kan, as grand coordinator of Fujian, killed Vice Minister Hong Chaoxuan.
translations.idiomatic: Lao Kan, as grand coordinator of Fujian, killed Vice Minister Hong Chaoxuan.

sentences.zh: 御史張一鯤監應天鄉試，王篆子之鼎夤緣中式。

translations.literal: The Censor Zhang Yikun supervised the provincial examination of Yingtian; Wang Zhuan's son Zhi Ding obtained a jinshi degree through illicit connections.
translations.idiomatic: The Censor Zhang Yikun supervised the provincial examination of Yingtian; Wang Zhuan's son Zhi Ding obtained a jinshi degree through illicit connections.

sentences.zh: 錢岱監湖廣鄉試，先期請居正少子還就試，會居正卒不果，遂私中篆子之衡。

translations.literal: Qian Dai supervised the provincial examination of Huguang and in advance requested that Zhang Juzheng's youngest son return to take the examination; when Juzheng died the plan failed, and he privately placed Zhuan's son Zhiheng on the list.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Dai supervised the provincial examination of Huguang and in advance requested that Zhang Juzheng's youngest son return to take the examination; when Juzheng died the plan failed, and he privately placed Zhuan's son Zhiheng on the list.

sentences.zh: 曹一夔身居風憲，盛稱馮保為顧命大臣。

translations.literal: Cao Yikui, holding the power of the censorate, loudly praised Feng Bao as a chief minister appointed on the deathbed.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Yikui, holding the power of the censorate, loudly praised Feng Bao as a chief minister appointed on the deathbed.

sentences.zh: 硃璉則結馮保為父，游七為兄。

translations.literal: Zhu Lian made Feng Bao his adoptive father and You Qi his adoptive elder brother.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Lian made Feng Bao his adoptive father and You Qi his adoptive elder brother.

sentences.zh: 此數人者，得罪名教，而亦止罷官。

translations.literal: These several men have offended the teachings of moral culture, yet they too were only dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: These several men have offended the teachings of moral culture, yet they too were only dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 此綱紀所以不振，人心所以不服。

translations.literal: This is why discipline and standards fail to be upheld and hearts do not submit.
translations.idiomatic: This is why discipline and standards fail to be upheld and hearts do not submit.

sentences.zh: 臣初八台，誓掃除積弊。

translations.literal: When Your servant first entered the Censorate, he vowed to sweep away longstanding abuses.
translations.idiomatic: When I first entered the Censorate, I vowed to sweep away longstanding abuses.

sentences.zh: 今待罪三月，而大吏恣肆，小吏貪殘，小民怨咨，四方賂遺如故，臣不職可見。

translations.literal: Now after three months in a degraded post, grand officials act without restraint, petty officials are greedy and cruel, common people murmur in complaint, and gifts from all quarters continue as before—my unfitness for office is plain to see.
translations.idiomatic: Now after three months in a degraded post, grand officials act without restraint, petty officials are greedy and cruel, common people murmur in complaint, and gifts from all quarters continue as before—my unfitness for office is plain to see.

sentences.zh: 請罷斥以儆有位。」

translations.literal: I beg to be dismissed to warn those who hold high position."
translations.idiomatic: I beg to be dismissed to warn those who hold high position."

sentences.zh: 時已遷刑部右侍郎。

translations.literal: By then he had already been transferred to Right Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: By then he had already been transferred to Right Vice Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 帝優詔報之。

translations.literal: The Emperor responded with a gracious edict.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor responded with a gracious edict.

sentences.zh: 召時亮、世選、檟、復聘、汝桂還，削慶昌、堪、一鯤、一夔、璉籍，貶岱三秩。

translations.literal: He recalled Shiliang, Shixuan, Jiao, Fupin, and Rugui; struck Qingchang, Kan, Yikun, Yikui, and Lian from the registers; and demoted Dai by three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: He recalled Shiliang, Shixuan, Jiao, Fupin, and Rugui; struck Yingchang, Kan, Yikun, Yikui, and Lian from the registers; and demoted Dai by three ranks.

sentences.zh: 未幾，偕中官張誠往籍張居正家。

translations.literal: Not long after, he went together with the eunuch Zhang Cheng to confiscate the household of Zhang Juzheng.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, he went together with the eunuch Zhang Cheng to confiscate the household of Zhang Juzheng.

sentences.zh: 還，轉左侍郎，增俸一秩。

translations.literal: On his return he was transferred to Left Vice Minister and given an additional rank of salary.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was transferred to Left Vice Minister and given an additional rank of salary.

sentences.zh: 尋拜南京吏部尚書，卒官。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed Minister of Personnel in Nanjing and died in office.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed Minister of Personnel in Nanjing and died in office.

sentences.zh: 贈太子太保，諡簡肅。

translations.literal: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous epithet Jiansu.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous epithet Jiansu.

sentences.zh: 橓強直好搏擊，其清節為時所稱雲。

translations.literal: Qiao was forceful and upright and loved to attack wrongdoing; his integrity was praised by his contemporaries.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao was forceful and upright and loved to attack wrongdoing; his integrity was praised by his contemporaries.

sentences.zh: 呂坤，字叔簡，甯陵人。

translations.literal: Lu Kun, styled Shujian, was a man of Ningling.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Kun, styled Shujian, was a native of Ningling.

sentences.zh: 萬曆二年進士。

translations.literal: In the second year of Wanli he passed the metropolitan examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Wanli he passed the metropolitan examination.

sentences.zh: 為襄垣知縣，有異政。

translations.literal: As magistrate of Xiangyuan he distinguished himself with exceptional governance.
translations.idiomatic: As magistrate of Xiangyuan he distinguished himself with exceptional governance.

sentences.zh: 調大同，征授戶部主事，曆郎中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Datong, then summoned and appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue; he rose through the ranks to director.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Datong, then summoned and appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue; he rose through the ranks to director.

sentences.zh: 遷山東參政、山西按察使、陝西右布政使。

translations.literal: He was moved to administrative commissioner of Shandong, surveillance commissioner of Shanxi, and right provincial administration commissioner of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was moved to administrative commissioner of Shandong, surveillance commissioner of Shanxi, and right provincial administration commissioner of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 擢右僉都御史，巡撫山西。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Right Censor and grand coordinator of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Right Censor and grand coordinator of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 居三年，召為左僉都御史。

translations.literal: After three years in that post he was recalled as Left Censor.
translations.idiomatic: After three years in that post he was recalled as Left Censor.

sentences.zh: 曆刑部左、右侍郎。

translations.literal: He served successively as left and right vice minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as left and right vice minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 二十五年五月，書疏陳天下安危，其略曰：

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twenty-fifth year of Wanli he submitted a memorial setting forth the safety or danger of the realm; its gist read:
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-fifth year of Wanli he submitted a memorial setting forth the safety or danger of the realm; its gist read:

sentences.zh: 竊見元旦以來，天氣昏黃，日光黯淡，占者以為亂徵。

translations.literal: Your servant observes that since New Year's Day the weather has been murky and yellow, the sunlight dim—diviners take this as a sign of disorder.
translations.idiomatic: I observe that since New Year's Day the weather has been murky and yellow, the sunlight dim—diviners take this as a sign of disorder.

sentences.zh: 今天下之勢，亂象已形，而亂勢未動。

translations.literal: Today the trend of the realm already shows the image of disorder, though the momentum of disorder has not yet moved.
translations.idiomatic: Today the trend of the realm already shows the image of disorder, though the momentum of disorder has not yet moved.

sentences.zh: 天下之人，亂心已萌，而亂人未倡。

translations.literal: The people of the realm already harbor hearts inclined to disorder, though the men who would raise disorder have not yet taken the lead.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the realm already harbor hearts inclined to disorder, though the men who would raise disorder have not yet taken the lead.

sentences.zh: 今日之政，皆播亂機使之動，助亂人使之倡者也。

translations.literal: The policies of today all scatter the mechanisms that make disorder move and assist the men who make disorder take the lead.
translations.idiomatic: The policies of today all scatter the mechanisms that make disorder move and assist the men who make disorder take the lead.

sentences.zh: 臣敢以救時要務，為陛下陳之。

translations.literal: Your servant dares set forth urgent tasks to save the times for Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: I dare set forth urgent tasks to save the times for Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 自古幸亂之民有四。

translations.literal: Since antiquity there have been four kinds of people who rejoice in disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity there have been four kinds of people who rejoice in disorder.

sentences.zh: 一曰無聊之民。

translations.literal: First, people without occupation.
translations.idiomatic: First, people without occupation.

sentences.zh: 飽溫無由，身家俱困，因懷逞亂之心，冀緩須臾之死。

translations.literal: Unable to obtain warmth and full bellies, their persons and households alike in distress, they therefore harbor thoughts of reckless disorder, hoping to postpone death for a little while.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to obtain warmth and full bellies, their persons and households alike in distress, they therefore harbor thoughts of reckless disorder, hoping to postpone death for a little while.

sentences.zh: 二曰無行之民。

translations.literal: Second, people without proper conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Second, people without proper conduct.

sentences.zh: 氣高性悍，玩法輕生，居常愛玉帛子女而不得，及有變則淫掠是圖。

translations.literal: Proud in spirit and fierce by nature, they treat the law lightly and hold life cheap; in ordinary times they covet jade, silk, women, and children without obtaining them, and when trouble comes they aim at plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Proud in spirit and fierce by nature, they treat the law lightly and hold life cheap; in ordinary times they covet jade, silk, women, and children without obtaining them, and when trouble comes they aim at plunder.

sentences.zh: 三曰邪說之民。

translations.literal: Third, people of heterodox teachings.
translations.idiomatic: Third, people of heterodox teachings.

sentences.zh: 白蓮結社，遍及四方，教主傳頭，所在成聚。

translations.literal: The White Lotus societies have spread in all directions; wherever the cult leader passes on leadership, crowds assemble.
translations.idiomatic: The White Lotus societies have spread in all directions; wherever the cult leader passes on leadership, crowds assemble.

sentences.zh: 倘有招呼之首，此其歸附之人。

translations.literal: Should there arise a man to summon them, these are the ones who would attach themselves to him.
translations.idiomatic: Should there arise a man to summon them, these are the ones who would attach themselves to him.

sentences.zh: 四曰不軌之民。

translations.literal: Fourth, people of unlawful intent.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, people of unlawful intent.

sentences.zh: 乘釁蹈機，妄思雄長。

translations.literal: They seize opportunities and tread on crises, rashly hoping to play the bold leader.
translations.idiomatic: They seize opportunities and tread on crises, rashly hoping to play the bold leader.

sentences.zh: 惟冀目前有變，不樂天下太平。

translations.literal: They only hope for turmoil before their eyes and do not rejoice in peace under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: They only hope for turmoil before their eyes and do not rejoice in peace under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 陛下約己愛人，損上益上，則四民皆赤子，否則悉為寇仇。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty restrains yourself and cherishes the people, reducing what is taken from above to benefit those below, then the four classes will all be your true children; otherwise they will all become enemies and foes.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty restrains yourself and cherishes the people, reducing what is taken from above to benefit those below, then the four classes will all be your true children; otherwise they will all become enemies and foes.

sentences.zh: 今天下之蒼生貧困可知矣。

translations.literal: Today the destitution of the common people under Heaven can clearly be seen.
translations.idiomatic: Today the destitution of the common people under Heaven can clearly be seen.

sentences.zh: 自萬曆十年以來，無歲不災，催科如故。

translations.literal: Since the tenth year of Wanli there has been disaster every year, yet tax collection proceeds as before.
translations.idiomatic: Since the tenth year of Wanli there has been disaster every year, yet tax collection proceeds as before.

sentences.zh: 臣久為外吏，見陛下赤子凍骨無兼衣，饑腸不再食，垣舍弗蔽，苫槁未完；

translations.literal: Your servant long served as a local official and has seen Your Majesty's true children with frozen bones who have no second garment, hungry bellies that know no second meal, walls and houses unroofed, thatched sheds unfinished;
translations.idiomatic: I long served as a local official and have seen Your Majesty's true children with frozen bones who have no second garment, hungry bellies that know no second meal, walls and houses unroofed, thatched sheds unfinished;

sentences.zh: 流移日眾，棄地猥多；

translations.literal: refugees increase day by day, and abandoned land grows vast.
translations.idiomatic: refugees increase day by day, and abandoned land grows vast.

sentences.zh: 留者輸去者之糧，生者承死者之役。

translations.literal: Those who remain must deliver grain for those who have left; the living must bear the corvée duties of the dead.
translations.idiomatic: Those who remain must deliver grain for those who have fled; the living must bear the corvée duties of the dead.

sentences.zh: 君門萬里，孰能仰訴？

translations.literal: The palace gates are ten thousand li away—who can look up and plead?
translations.idiomatic: The palace gates are ten thousand li away—who can look up and plead?

sentences.zh: 今國家之財用耗竭可知矣。

translations.literal: Today the exhaustion of the state's finances can clearly be seen.
translations.idiomatic: Today the exhaustion of the state's finances can clearly be seen.

sentences.zh: 數年以來，壽宮之費幾百萬，織造之費幾百萬，寧夏之變幾百萬，黃河之潰幾百萬，今大工、采木費，又各幾百萬矣。

translations.literal: Over the past several years, expenses for the longevity palace have amounted to millions, weaving and manufacture to millions, the Ningxia rebellion to millions, the Yellow River breach to millions—and now great works and timber-gathering each cost millions more.
translations.idiomatic: Over the past several years, expenses for the longevity palace have run to millions, weaving and manufacture to millions, the Ningxia rebellion to millions, the Yellow River breach to millions—and now great works and timber-gathering each cost millions more.

sentences.zh: 土不加廣，民不加多，非有雨菽湧金，安能為計？

translations.literal: The land does not grow wider and the people do not grow more numerous—unless beans and gold rain from the sky, how can such accounts be met?
translations.idiomatic: The land does not grow wider and the people do not grow more numerous—unless beans and gold rain from the sky, how can such accounts be met?

sentences.zh: 今國家之防禦疏略可知矣。

translations.literal: Today the laxity of the state's defenses can clearly be seen.
translations.idiomatic: Today the laxity of the state's defenses can clearly be seen.

sentences.zh: 三大營之兵以衛京師也，乃馬半羸敝，人半老弱。

translations.literal: The troops of the three great camps exist to guard the capital, yet half the horses are emaciated and worn, half the men old and weak.
translations.idiomatic: The troops of the three great camps exist to guard the capital, yet half the horses are emaciated and worn, half the men old and weak.

sentences.zh: 九邊之兵以禦外寇也，皆勇於挾上，怯於臨戎。

translations.literal: The troops of the nine border regions exist to repel foreign invaders, yet all are bold in oppressing their superiors and timid in facing the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: The troops of the nine border regions exist to repel foreign invaders, yet all are bold in oppressing their superiors and timid in facing the enemy.

sentences.zh: 外衛之兵以備徵調資守禦也，伍缺於役占，家累于需求，皮骨僅存，折沖奚賴？

translations.literal: The outer garrison troops exist to supply mobilization and support defense, yet companies are depleted by corvée requisition, households crushed by exactions—only skin and bone remain; on whom can one rely to repel the foe?
translations.idiomatic: The outer garrison troops exist to supply mobilization and support defense, yet companies are depleted by corvée requisition, households crushed by exactions—only skin and bone remain; on whom can one rely to repel the foe?

sentences.zh: 設有千騎橫行，兵不足用，必選民丁。

translations.literal: Should a thousand horsemen ride rampant, the troops would not suffice and civilian conscripts would have to be chosen.
translations.idiomatic: Should a thousand horsemen ride rampant, the troops would not suffice and civilian conscripts would have to be chosen.

sentences.zh: 以怨民鬥怨民，誰與合戰？

translations.literal: To set resentful commoners fighting resentful commoners—who will join battle together?
translations.idiomatic: To set resentful commoners fighting resentful commoners—who will join battle together?

sentences.zh: 人心者，國家之命脈也。

translations.literal: The hearts of the people are the lifeblood of the state.
translations.idiomatic: The hearts of the people are the lifeblood of the state.

sentences.zh: 今日之人心，惟望陛下收之而已。

translations.literal: The hearts of the people today only hope that Your Majesty will win them back.
translations.idiomatic: The hearts of the people today only hope that Your Majesty will win them back.

sentences.zh: 關隴氣寒土薄，民生實艱。

translations.literal: Guanlong's air is cold and its soil thin; the people's livelihood is truly hard.
translations.idiomatic: Guanlong's air is cold and its soil thin; the people's livelihood is truly hard.

sentences.zh: 自造花絨，比戶困趣逼。

translations.literal: Since the manufacture of patterned velvet began, every household has been driven to distress.
translations.idiomatic: Since the manufacture of patterned velvet began, every household has been driven to distress.

sentences.zh: 提花染色，日夜無休，千手經年，不成一匹。

translations.literal: Raising patterns and applying dyes, day and night without rest—a thousand hands labor for a year and cannot finish one bolt.
translations.idiomatic: Raising patterns and applying dyes, day and night without rest—a thousand hands labor for a year and cannot finish one bolt.

sentences.zh: 他若山西之，蘇、松之錦綺，歲額既盈，加造不已。

translations.literal: Likewise Shanxi ramie, Suzhou and Songjiang brocades and silks—once the annual quota is filled, additional production never ceases.
translations.idiomatic: Likewise Shanxi ramie, Suzhou and Songjiang brocades and silks—once the annual quota is filled, additional production never ceases.

sentences.zh: 至饒州磁器，西域回青，不急之須，徒累小民敲骨。

translations.literal: As for Raozhou porcelain and Western Regions cobalt blue, they are not urgent needs yet they only burden common people to the bone.
translations.idiomatic: As for Raozhou porcelain and Western Regions cobalt blue, they are not urgent needs yet they only burden common people to the bone.

sentences.zh: 陛下誠一切停罷，而江南、陝西之人心收矣。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty will truly halt all of these entirely, then the hearts of Jiangnan and Shaanxi will be won back.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty will truly halt all of these entirely, then the hearts of Jiangnan and Shaanxi will be won back.

sentences.zh: 以采木言之。

translations.literal: To speak of timber-gathering:
translations.idiomatic: To speak of timber-gathering:

sentences.zh: 丈八之圍，非百年之物。

translations.literal: A trunk eight chi in girth is not a thing of a mere hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: A trunk eight chi in girth is not a thing of a mere hundred years.

sentences.zh: 深山窮穀，蛇虎雜居，毒霧常多，人煙絕少，寒暑饑渴瘴癘死者無論矣。

translations.literal: In deep mountains and remote valleys snakes and tigers dwell together, poisonous mists are frequent, human habitation is extremely sparse—to say nothing of those who die from cold, heat, hunger, thirst, and malarial vapors.
translations.idiomatic: In deep mountains and remote valleys snakes and tigers dwell together, poisonous mists are frequent, human habitation is extremely sparse—to say nothing of those who die from cold, heat, hunger, thirst, and malarial vapors.

sentences.zh: 乃一木初臥，千夫難移，倘遇阻艱，必成傷殞。

translations.literal: Yet when one tree first lies felled, a thousand men can scarcely move it; should they meet obstruction and hardship, injuries and deaths are inevitable.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when one tree first lies felled, a thousand men can scarcely move it; should they meet obstruction and hardship, injuries and deaths are inevitable.

sentences.zh: 蜀民語曰：「入山一千，出山五百」。

translations.literal: The people of Shu have a saying: "A thousand enter the mountains, five hundred leave them."
translations.idiomatic: The people of Shu have a saying: "A thousand enter the mountains, five hundred leave them."

sentences.zh: 哀可知也。

translations.literal: The sorrow can be imagined.
translations.idiomatic: The sorrow can be imagined.

sentences.zh: 至若海木，官價雖一株千兩，比來都下，為費何止萬金！

translations.literal: As for timber from the sea, though the official price is a thousand taels per tree, in the capital lately the cost has been far more than ten thousand in gold!
translations.idiomatic: As for timber from the sea, though the official price is a thousand taels per tree, in the capital lately the cost has been far more than ten thousand in gold!

sentences.zh: 臣見楚、蜀之人，談及采木，莫不哽咽。

translations.literal: Your servant has seen the people of Chu and Shu—when they speak of timber-gathering, none can do so without choking with grief.
translations.idiomatic: I have seen the people of Chu and Shu—when they speak of timber-gathering, none can do so without choking with grief.

sentences.zh: 苟損其數，增其直，多其歲月，減其尺寸，而川、貴、湖廣之人心收矣。

translations.literal: If the number were reduced, the price increased, the time extended, and the dimensions lessened, then the hearts of Sichuan, Guizhou, and Huguang would be won back.
translations.idiomatic: If the number were reduced, the price increased, the time extended, and the dimensions lessened, then the hearts of Sichuan, Guizhou, and Huguang would be won back.

sentences.zh: 以採礦言之。

translations.literal: To speak of mining:
translations.idiomatic: To speak of mining:

sentences.zh: 南陽諸府，比歲饑荒。

translations.literal: The prefectures of Nanyang have suffered famine in recent years.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectures of Nanyang have suffered famine in recent years.

sentences.zh: 生氣方蘇，菜色未變。

translations.literal: Life has just revived and the look of hunger has not yet faded.
translations.idiomatic: Life has just revived and the look of hunger has not yet faded.

sentences.zh: 自責報殷戶，是半已驚逃。

translations.literal: Since prosperous households were registered for tribute quotas, half have already fled in alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Since prosperous households were registered for tribute quotas, half have already fled in alarm.

sentences.zh: 自供應礦夫工食、官兵口糧，而多至累死。

translations.literal: Since supplying miners' rations and soldiers' provisions, many have been worked to death.
translations.idiomatic: Since supplying miners' rations and soldiers' provisions, many have been worked to death.

sentences.zh: 自都御史李盛春嚴旨切責，而撫按畏罪不敢言。

translations.literal: Since Censor-in-Chief Li Shengchun received stern orders and sharp rebuke, the provincial governors and surveillance commissioners fear punishment and dare not speak.
translations.idiomatic: Since Censor-in-Chief Li Shengchun received stern orders and sharp rebuke, the provincial governors and surveillance commissioners fear punishment and dare not speak.

sentences.zh: 今礦沙無利，責民納銀，而奸人仲春復為攘奪侵漁之計。

translations.literal: Now the ore yields no profit, yet the people are charged to deliver silver—and the scoundrel Zhong Chun again devises schemes of seizure and plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Now the ore yields no profit, yet the people are charged to deliver silver—and the scoundrel Zhong Chun again devises schemes of seizure and plunder.

sentences.zh: 朝廷得一金，郡縣費千倍。

translations.literal: The court gains one ounce of gold while the prefectures and districts spend a thousandfold.
translations.idiomatic: The court gains one ounce of gold while the prefectures and districts spend a thousandfold.

sentences.zh: 誠敕戒使者，毋散砂責銀，有侵奪小民若仲春者，誅無赦，而四方之人心收矣。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty will truly command the envoys not to demand silver for worthless sand, and execute without mercy any who plunder common people as Zhong Chun does, then the hearts of the four quarters will be won back.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty will truly command the envoys not to demand silver for worthless sand, and execute without mercy any who plunder common people as Zhong Chun does, then the hearts of the four quarters will be won back.

sentences.zh: 宮店租銀收解，自趙承勳造四千之說，而皇店開。

translations.literal: As for the collection and delivery of shop-rent silver, since Zhao Chengxun invented the tale of four thousand, imperial shops were opened.
translations.idiomatic: As for the collection and delivery of shop-rent silver, since Zhao Chengxun invented the tale of four thousand, imperial shops were opened.

sentences.zh: 自朝廷有內官之遣，而事權重。

translations.literal: Since the court began dispatching inner-court eunuchs, their power grew heavy.
translations.idiomatic: Since the court began dispatching inner-court eunuchs, their power grew heavy.

sentences.zh: 夫市井之地，貧民求升合絲毫以活身家者也，陛下享萬方之富，何賴於彼？

translations.literal: Marketplaces are places where poor people seek a cup or a grain to sustain their persons and households—Your Majesty enjoys the wealth of all regions; why rely on them?
translations.idiomatic: Marketplaces are places where poor people seek a cup or a grain to sustain their persons and households—Your Majesty enjoys the wealth of all regions; why rely on them?

sentences.zh: 且馮保八店，為屋幾何，而歲有四千金之課。

translations.literal: Moreover Feng Bao's eight shops—how many buildings do they occupy?—yet the annual levy is four thousand in gold.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Feng Bao's eight shops—how many buildings do they occupy?—yet the annual levy is four thousand in gold.

sentences.zh: 課既四千，徵收何止數倍。

translations.literal: Once the levy is four thousand, collection is surely several times more.
translations.idiomatic: Once the levy is four thousand, collection is surely several times more.

sentences.zh: 不奪市民，將安取之？

translations.literal: If one does not seize from city dwellers, whence will it be taken?
translations.idiomatic: If one does not seize from city dwellers, whence will it be taken?

sentences.zh: 今豪家遣僕設肆，居民尚受其殃，況特遣中貴，賜之敕書，以壓卵之威，行竭澤之計，民困豈顧問哉？

translations.literal: Today when great families send servants to set up shops, residents still suffer harm—how much more when specially dispatched palace eunuchs are granted imperial edicts, wielding the power to crush an egg and carrying out a plan to drain the pond dry; will the people's distress be heeded?
translations.idiomatic: Today when great families send servants to set up shops, residents still suffer harm—how much more when specially dispatched palace eunuchs are granted imperial edicts, wielding the power to crush an egg and carrying out a plan to drain the pond dry; will the people's distress be heeded?

sentences.zh: 陛下撤還內臣，責有司輸課，而畿甸之人心收矣。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty will recall the inner-court eunuchs and charge the local officials to deliver the levies, then the hearts of the capital region will be won back.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty will recall the inner-court eunuchs and charge the local officials to deliver the levies, then the hearts of the capital region will be won back.

sentences.zh: 天下宗室，皆九廟子孫。

translations.literal: The imperial clansmen throughout the realm are all descendants of the nine ancestral temples.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial clansmen throughout the realm are all descendants of the nine ancestral temples.

sentences.zh: 王守仁、王錦襲蓋世神奸，藉隔數千里，而冒認王弼子孫；

translations.literal: Wang Shouren and Wang Jinxi, inheritors of consummate villainy, relying on a distance of several thousand li, falsely claimed to be descendants of Wang Bi;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shouren and Wang Jinxi, inheritors of consummate villainy, relying on a distance of several thousand li, falsely claimed to be descendants of Wang Bi;

sentences.zh: 事隔三百年，而妄稱受寄財產。

translations.literal: though the matter was separated by three hundred years, they rashly claimed entrusted property.
translations.idiomatic: though the matter was separated by three hundred years, they rashly claimed entrusted property.

sentences.zh: 中間偽造絲綸，假傳詔旨，明欺聖主，暗陷親王，有如楚王銜恨自殺，陛下何辭以謝高皇帝之靈乎？

translations.literal: In between they forged imperial silks and falsely transmitted edicts, openly deceiving the sage ruler and secretly trapping a princely kinsman—as when the Prince of Chu died bearing resentment by his own hand; with what words can Your Majesty answer the spirit of the Founding Emperor?
translations.idiomatic: In between they forged imperial silks and falsely transmitted edicts, openly deceiving the sage ruler and secretly trapping a princely kinsman—as when the Prince of Chu died bearing resentment by his own hand; with what words can Your Majesty answer the spirit of the Founding Emperor?

sentences.zh: 此兩賊者，罪應誅殛，乃止令回籍，臣恐萬姓驚疑。

translations.literal: These two villains deserved execution, yet they were only ordered back to their native places—I fear the myriad people are alarmed and doubtful.
translations.idiomatic: These two villains deserved execution, yet they were only ordered back to their native places—I fear the myriad people are alarmed and doubtful.

sentences.zh: 誠急斬二賊以謝楚王，而天下宗籓之心收矣。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty will truly swiftly execute the two villains to appease the Prince of Chu, then the hearts of the imperial clans throughout the realm will be won back.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty will truly swiftly execute the two villains to appease the Prince of Chu, then the hearts of the imperial clans throughout the realm will be won back.

sentences.zh: 崇信伯費甲金之貧，十廂珠寶之誣，皆通國所知也。

translations.literal: The poverty of Marquis Chongxin Fei Jiajin and the false charge of ten cases of jewels are known throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The poverty of Marquis Chongxin Fei Jiajin and the false charge of ten cases of jewels are known throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 始誤於科道之風聞，嚴追猶未為過。

translations.literal: At first one was misled by rumor from the censorate and surveillance bureau—a strict pursuit was not yet excessive.
translations.idiomatic: At first one was misled by rumor from the censorate and surveillance bureau—a strict pursuit was not yet excessive.

sentences.zh: 今真知其枉，又加禁錮，實害無辜。

translations.literal: Now knowing his innocence, yet adding imprisonment—this truly harms the guiltless.
translations.idiomatic: Now knowing his innocence, yet adding imprisonment—this truly harms the guiltless.

sentences.zh: 請還甲金革去之祿，復五城廠衛降斥之官，而勳戚之人心收矣。

translations.literal: I beg that Jiajin be restored and his stipend returned, and that the officials of the Five Wards and the factory guards who were demoted and dismissed be reinstated—then the hearts of meritorious kinsmen will be won back.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that Jiajin be restored and his stipend returned, and that the officials of the Five Wards and the factory guards who were demoted and dismissed be reinstated—then the hearts of meritorious kinsmen will be won back.

sentences.zh: 法者所以平天下之情。

translations.literal: Law exists to level the feelings of all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Law exists to level the feelings of all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 其輕其重，太祖既定為律，列聖又增為例。

translations.literal: Its lightness and severity the Founding Emperor fixed as statutes, and successive sage emperors added precedents.
translations.idiomatic: Its lightness and severity the Founding Emperor fixed as statutes, and successive sage emperors added precedents.

sentences.zh: 如輕重可以就喜怒之情，則例不得為一定之法。

translations.literal: If lightness and severity may follow the mood of joy or anger, then precedents cannot serve as fixed law.
translations.idiomatic: If lightness and severity may follow the mood of joy or anger, then precedents cannot serve as fixed law.

sentences.zh: 臣待罪刑部三年矣，每見詔獄一下，持平者多拂上意，從重者皆當聖心。

translations.literal: Your servant has awaited punishment in the Ministry of Justice for three years; each time an imperial prison case is opened, those who hold the balance often go against the sovereign's intent, while those who follow the heavier penalty always match the sage heart.
translations.idiomatic: I have awaited punishment in the Ministry of Justice for three years; each time an imperial prison case is opened, those who hold the balance often go against the sovereign's intent, while those who follow the heavier penalty always match the sage heart.

sentences.zh: 如往年陳恕、王正甄、常照等獄，臣等欺天罔人，已自廢法，陛下猶以為輕，俱加大辟。

translations.literal: As in the cases of Chen Shu, Wang Zhenzhen, and Chang Zhao in former years—we deceived Heaven and misled men and ourselves abandoned the law, yet Your Majesty still thought it too light and all were given the death penalty.
translations.idiomatic: As in the cases of Chen Shu, Wang Zhenzhen, and Chang Zhao in former years—we deceived Heaven and misled men and ourselves abandoned the law, yet Your Majesty still thought it too light and all were given the death penalty.

sentences.zh: 然則律例又安用乎！

translations.literal: Then of what use are statutes and precedents!
translations.idiomatic: Then of what use are statutes and precedents!

sentences.zh: 誠俯從司寇之平，勉就祖宗之法，而囹圄之人心收矣。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty will truly defer to the Minister of Justice's balanced judgment and strive to follow the laws of the ancestors, then the hearts of those in prison will be won back.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty will truly defer to the Minister of Justice's balanced judgment and strive to follow the laws of the ancestors, then the hearts of those in prison will be won back.

sentences.zh: 自古聖明之君，豈樂誹謗之語。

translations.literal: Since antiquity, have sage and enlightened rulers rejoiced in slanderous words?
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity, have sage and enlightened rulers rejoiced in slanderous words?

sentences.zh: 然而務求言賞諫者，知天下存亡，系言路通塞也。

translations.literal: Yet they earnestly sought words and rewarded remonstrance because they knew that the survival or destruction of the realm depends on whether the avenue of speech is open or blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Yet they earnestly sought words and rewarded remonstrance because they knew that the survival or destruction of the realm depends on whether the avenue of speech is open or blocked.

sentences.zh: 比來驅逐既多，選補皆罷。

translations.literal: Lately many have been driven out and replacements have all been halted.
translations.idiomatic: Lately many have been driven out and replacements have all been halted.

sentences.zh: 天閽邃密，法座崇嚴，若不廣達四聰，何由明照萬里？

translations.literal: The heavenly gate is deep and secluded, the dharma seat lofty and solemn—if one does not broadly extend the four keen ears, how can one clearly illuminate ten thousand li?
translations.idiomatic: The heavenly gate is deep and secluded, the dharma seat lofty and solemn—if one does not broadly extend the four keen ears, how can one clearly illuminate ten thousand li?

sentences.zh: 今陛下所聞，皆眾人之所敢言也，其不敢言者，陛下不得聞矣。

translations.literal: What Your Majesty hears today is only what the multitude dares to say; what they dare not say, Your Majesty cannot hear.
translations.idiomatic: What Your Majesty hears today is only what the multitude dares to say; what they dare not say, Your Majesty cannot hear.

sentences.zh: 一人孤立萬乘之上，舉朝無犯顏逆耳之人，快在一時，憂貽他日。

translations.literal: One man stands alone above ten thousand chariots, and the whole court has no one who offends the countenance or grates on the ear—pleasure for a moment, but worry for days to come.
translations.idiomatic: One man stands alone above ten thousand chariots, and the whole court has no one who offends the countenance or grates on the ear—pleasure for a moment, but worry for days to come.

sentences.zh: 陛下誠釋曹學程之系，還吳文梓等官，凡建言得罪者，悉分別召用，而士大夫之心收矣。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty will truly release Cao Xuecheng from bonds, restore Wu Wenzhi and others to office, and recall and employ separately all who were punished for memorializing, then the hearts of scholar-officials will be won back.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty will truly release Cao Xuecheng from bonds, restore Wu Wenzhi and others to office, and recall and employ separately all who were punished for memorializing, then the hearts of scholar-officials will be won back.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮密邇東陲，近吾肘腋，平壤西鄰鴨綠，晉州直對登、萊。

translations.literal: Korea borders closely on the eastern frontier, near our elbow and armpit—Pyongyang adjoins the Yalu to the west, and Jinzhou directly faces Dengzhou and Laizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Korea borders closely on the eastern frontier, near our elbow and armpit—Pyongyang adjoins the Yalu to the west, and Jinzhou directly faces Dengzhou and Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 倘倭夷取而有之，籍眾為兵，就地資食，進則斷我漕運，退則窺我遼東。

translations.literal: Should the Japanese barbarians seize and hold it, enroll the masses as soldiers, and supply food on the spot, advancing they would cut our grain transport by sea and retreating they would spy on our Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Should the Japanese barbarians seize and hold it, enroll the masses as soldiers, and supply food on the spot, advancing they would cut our grain transport by sea and retreating they would spy on our Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 不及一年，京城坐困，此國家大憂也。

translations.literal: In less than a year the capital would sit trapped—this is a great worry for the state.
translations.idiomatic: In less than a year the capital would sit trapped—this is a great worry for the state.

sentences.zh: 乃彼請兵而二三其說，許兵而延緩其期；

translations.literal: Yet when they request troops the explanations are contradictory, and when troops are promised the deadline is delayed;
translations.idiomatic: Yet when they request troops the explanations are contradictory, and when troops are promised the deadline is delayed;

sentences.zh: 力窮勢屈，不折入為倭不止。

translations.literal: when strength is exhausted and the situation desperate, unless they submit they will not cease to be Japanese.
translations.idiomatic: when strength is exhausted and the situation desperate, unless they submit they will not cease to be Japanese.

sentences.zh: 陛下誠早決大計，並力東征，而屬國之人心收矣。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty will truly decide the great plan early and unite strength for an eastern campaign, then the hearts of the tributary state will be won back.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty will truly decide the great plan early and unite strength for an eastern campaign, then the hearts of the tributary state will be won back.

sentences.zh: 四方輸解之物，營辦既苦，轉運尤艱。

translations.literal: Goods delivered in tribute from the four quarters are already painful to procure, and transport is especially arduous.
translations.idiomatic: Goods delivered in tribute from the four quarters are already painful to procure, and transport is especially arduous.

sentences.zh: 及入內庫，率至朽爛，萬姓脂膏，化為塵土。

translations.literal: Once they enter the inner treasury they mostly rot away—the fat and cream of the myriad people turn to dust.
translations.idiomatic: Once they enter the inner treasury they mostly rot away—the fat and cream of the myriad people turn to dust.

sentences.zh: 倘歲一稽核，苦窳者嚴監收之刑，朽腐者重典守之罪。

translations.literal: If there were an annual audit, imposing strict penalties on receivers for shoddy goods and heavy punishment on custodians for rotten stores,
translations.idiomatic: If there were an annual audit, imposing strict penalties on receivers for shoddy goods and heavy punishment on custodians for rotten stores,

sentences.zh: 一整頓間，而一年可備三年之用，歲省不下百萬，而輸解之人心收矣。

translations.literal: with one round of rectification one year's supply could serve three years, saving no less than a million annually—and the hearts of those who deliver tribute will be won back.
translations.idiomatic: with one round of rectification one year's supply could serve three years, saving no less than a million annually—and the hearts of those who deliver tribute will be won back.

sentences.zh: 自抄沒法重，株連數多。

translations.literal: Since the law of confiscation grew heavy, implicated persons have been many.
translations.idiomatic: Since the law of confiscation grew heavy, implicated persons have been many.

sentences.zh: 坐以轉寄，則並籍家資。

translations.literal: Charge transfer of goods for safekeeping and the whole household's assets are registered and seized.
translations.idiomatic: Charge transfer of goods for safekeeping and the whole household's assets are registered and seized.

sentences.zh: 誣以多贓，則互連親識。

translations.literal: Falsely charge much stolen goods and relatives and acquaintances are implicated together.
translations.idiomatic: Falsely charge much stolen goods and relatives and acquaintances are implicated together.

sentences.zh: 宅一封而雞豚大半餓死，人一出則親戚不敢藏留。

translations.literal: Seal one house and most chickens and pigs starve to death; once a man goes out, kin dare not shelter him.
translations.idiomatic: Seal one house and most chickens and pigs starve to death; once a man goes out, kin dare not shelter him.

sentences.zh: 加以官吏法嚴，兵番搜苦，少年婦女，亦令解衣。

translations.literal: Add to this strict officials and soldiers searching with cruelty—even young women are ordered to disrobe.
translations.idiomatic: Add to this strict officials and soldiers searching with cruelty—even young women are ordered to disrobe.

sentences.zh: 臣曾見之，掩目酸鼻。

translations.literal: Your servant has seen this and covered his eyes, his nose stinging with acid grief.
translations.idiomatic: I have seen this and covered my eyes, my nose stinging with acid grief.

sentences.zh: 此豈盡正犯之家、重罪之人哉？

translations.literal: Are these all households of true offenders and men of grave crime?
translations.idiomatic: Are these all households of true offenders and men of grave crime?

sentences.zh: 一字相牽，百口難解。

translations.literal: One word links another and a hundred mouths cannot explain.
translations.idiomatic: One word links another and a hundred mouths cannot explain.

sentences.zh: 奸人又乘機恐嚇，挾取資財，不足不止。

translations.literal: Villains again seize the opportunity to intimidate and extort property, not stopping until they have enough.
translations.idiomatic: Villains again seize the opportunity to intimidate and extort property, not stopping until they have enough.

sentences.zh: 半年之內，擾遍京師，陛下知之否乎？

translations.literal: Within half a year disturbance has spread throughout the capital—does Your Majesty know this?
translations.idiomatic: Within half a year disturbance has spread throughout the capital—does Your Majesty know this?

sentences.zh: 願慎抄沒之舉，釋無辜之系，而都下之人心收矣。

translations.literal: I wish that confiscation be undertaken cautiously and the guiltless in bonds be released—then the hearts of those in the capital will be won back.
translations.idiomatic: I wish that confiscation be undertaken cautiously and the guiltless in bonds be released—then the hearts of those in the capital will be won back.

sentences.zh: 列聖在禦之時，豈少宦官宮妾，然死于箠楚者，未之多聞也。

translations.literal: When the successive sage emperors held the throne, were eunuchs and palace women ever few? Yet those who died under the whip and cudgel were not often heard of.
translations.idiomatic: When the successive sage emperors held the throne, were eunuchs and palace women ever few? Yet those who died under the whip and cudgel were not often heard of.

sentences.zh: 陛下數年以來，疑深怒盛。

translations.literal: Your Majesty in recent years has been deep in suspicion and abundant in wrath.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty in recent years has been deep in suspicion and abundant in wrath.

sentences.zh: 廣廷之中，狼籍血肉，宮禁之內，慘戚啼號。

translations.literal: In the broad court flesh and blood lie scattered; within the palace precincts mournful cries and wails sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the broad court flesh and blood lie scattered; within the palace precincts mournful cries and wails sound.

sentences.zh: 厲氣冤魂，乃聚福祥之地。

translations.literal: Fell vapors and wronged souls gather in a place of blessing and good omen.
translations.idiomatic: Fell vapors and wronged souls gather in a place of blessing and good omen.

sentences.zh: 今環門守戶之眾，皆傷心側目之人。

translations.literal: Today the multitude who guard the gates and keep the doors are all men with wounded hearts and sidelong glances.
translations.idiomatic: Today the multitude who guard the gates and keep the doors are all men with wounded hearts and sidelong glances.

sentences.zh: 外表忠勤，中藏憸毒。

translations.literal: Outwardly loyal and diligent, inwardly hiding malice.
translations.idiomatic: Outwardly loyal and diligent, inwardly hiding malice.

sentences.zh: 既朝暮不能自保，即九死何愛一身。

translations.literal: Since morning and evening they cannot protect themselves, what love have they for a single body against nine deaths?
translations.idiomatic: Since morning and evening they cannot protect themselves, what love have they for a single body against nine deaths?

sentences.zh: 陛下臥榻之側，同心者幾人？

translations.literal: Beside Your Majesty's couch, how many share one heart?
translations.idiomatic: Beside Your Majesty's couch, how many share one heart?

sentences.zh: 暮夜之際，防患者幾人？

translations.literal: In the dark of night, how many stand guard against harm?
translations.idiomatic: In the dark of night, how many stand guard against harm?

sentences.zh: 臣竊憂之。

translations.literal: Your servant privately worries about this.
translations.idiomatic: I privately worry about this.

sentences.zh: 願少霽威嚴，慎用鞭撲，而左右之人心收矣。

translations.literal: I wish that Your Majesty will slightly clear his august severity and use the whip and cudgel cautiously—then the hearts of those at your side will be won back.
translations.idiomatic: I wish that Your Majesty will slightly ease his august severity and use the whip and cudgel cautiously—then the hearts of those at your side will be won back.

sentences.zh: 祖宗以來，有一日三朝者，有一日一朝者。

translations.literal: Since the ancestors, some emperors held court three times a day, some once a day.
translations.idiomatic: Since the ancestors, some emperors held court three times a day, some once a day.

sentences.zh: 陛下不視朝久，人心懈弛已極，奸邪窺伺已深，守衛官軍祇應故事。

translations.literal: Your Majesty has long not attended court; hearts are slack to the utmost, villains watch and wait deeply, and the guard soldiers respond only as a formality.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty has long not attended court; hearts are slack to the utmost, villains watch and wait deeply, and the guard soldiers respond only as a formality.

sentences.zh: 今乾清修造，逼近御前，軍夫往來，誰識面貌？

translations.literal: Now the Qianqing Palace is under renovation, close before the imperial presence—soldiers and laborers come and go; who knows their faces?
translations.idiomatic: Now the Qianqing Palace is under renovation, close before the imperial presence—soldiers and laborers come and go; who knows their faces?

sentences.zh: 萬一不測，何以應之？

translations.literal: Should anything unforeseen occur, how will it be answered?
translations.idiomatic: Should anything unforeseen occur, how will it be answered?

sentences.zh: 臣望發宮鑰於質明，放軍夫於日昃。

translations.literal: Your servant hopes the palace keys will be issued at dawn and the soldiers and laborers dismissed at sunset.
translations.idiomatic: I hope the palace keys will be issued at dawn and the soldiers and laborers dismissed at sunset.

sentences.zh: 自非軍國急務，慎無昏夜傳宣。

translations.literal: Unless there is urgent military or state business, take care not to transmit orders in the dark of night.
translations.idiomatic: Unless there is urgent military or state business, take care not to transmit orders in the dark of night.

sentences.zh: 章奏不答，先朝未有。

translations.literal: Memorials unanswered—former dynasties had never known this.
translations.idiomatic: Memorials unanswered—former dynasties had never known this.

sentences.zh: 至於今日，強半留中。

translations.literal: As for today, more than half are kept within.
translations.idiomatic: As for today, more than half are kept within.

sentences.zh: 設令有國家大事，邀截實封，揚言於外曰「留中矣」，人知之乎？

translations.literal: Suppose there were a great matter of state and someone intercepted the sealed memorial and proclaimed outside, "It has been kept within"—would people know?
translations.idiomatic: Suppose there were a great matter of state and someone intercepted the sealed memorial and proclaimed outside, "It has been kept within"—would people know?

sentences.zh: 願自今章疏未及批答者，日於御前發一紙，下會極門，轉付諸司照察，庶君臣雖不面談，而上下猶無欺蔽。

translations.literal: I wish that from now on, for memorials not yet answered with a rescript, one sheet daily be issued before the throne and sent down through the Gate of Universal Reach to the various offices for inspection, so that though ruler and ministers do not meet face to face, above and below may still be without deception.
translations.idiomatic: I wish that from now on, for memorials not yet answered with a rescript, one sheet daily be issued before the throne and sent down through the Gate of Universal Reach to the various offices for inspection, so that though ruler and ministers do not meet face to face, above and below may still be without deception.

sentences.zh: 臣觀陛下昔時勵精為治，今當春秋鼎盛，曾無夙夜憂勤之意，惟孜孜以患貧為事。

translations.literal: Your servant observes that Your Majesty in former times strove with vigor to govern; now in the prime of life there is no thought of early and late worry and diligence, but only tireless concern with fear of poverty.
translations.idiomatic: I observe that Your Majesty in former times strove with vigor to govern; now in the prime of life there is no thought of early and late worry and diligence, but only tireless concern with fear of poverty.

sentences.zh: 不知天下之財，止有此數，君欲富則天下貧，天下貧而君豈獨富？

translations.literal: One does not know that the wealth of all under Heaven has only this measure—if the ruler grows rich then all under Heaven grows poor; if all under Heaven is poor, can the ruler alone be rich?
translations.idiomatic: One does not know that the wealth of all under Heaven has only this measure—if the ruler grows rich then all under Heaven grows poor; if all under Heaven is poor, can the ruler alone be rich?

sentences.zh: 今民生憔悴極矣，乃採辦日增，誅求益廣，斂萬姓之怨於一言，結九重之仇于四海，臣竊痛之。

translations.literal: Today the people's livelihood is exhausted to the utmost, yet procurement increases daily and exactions grow broader, gathering the resentment of the myriad people in a single word and forging enmity with the ninefold palace across the four seas—your servant privately grieves at this.
translations.idiomatic: Today the people's livelihood is exhausted to the utmost, yet procurement increases daily and exactions grow broader, gathering the resentment of the myriad people in a single word and forging enmity with the ninefold palace across the four seas—I privately grieve at this.

sentences.zh: 使六合一家，千年如故，即宮中虛無所有，誰忍使陛下獨貧？

translations.literal: If the six directions were one household and a thousand years unchanged, even were the palace utterly empty, who could bear to let Your Majesty alone be poor?
translations.idiomatic: If the six directions were one household and a thousand years unchanged, even were the palace utterly empty, who could bear to let Your Majesty alone be poor?

sentences.zh: 今禁城之內，不樂有君。

translations.literal: Today within the Forbidden City they take no joy in having a ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Today within the Forbidden City they take no joy in having a ruler.

sentences.zh: 天下之民，不樂有生。

translations.literal: The people of all under Heaven take no joy in being alive.
translations.idiomatic: The people of all under Heaven take no joy in being alive.

sentences.zh: 怨讟愁歎，難堪入聽。

translations.literal: Resentment, slander, grief, and sighs are unbearable to hear.
translations.idiomatic: Resentment, slander, grief, and sighs are unbearable to hear.

sentences.zh: 陛下聞之，必有食不能咽，寢不能安者矣。

translations.literal: When Your Majesty hears this, there must be times when food cannot be swallowed and sleep cannot be found.
translations.idiomatic: When Your Majesty hears this, there must be times when food cannot be swallowed and sleep cannot be found.

sentences.zh: 臣老且衰，恐不得復見太平，籲天叩地，齋宿七日，敬獻憂危之誠。

translations.literal: Your servant is old and declining, fearing he will not again see peace; he calls to Heaven and knocks upon the earth, fasts and purifies himself for seven days, and respectfully presents the sincerity of worry and danger.
translations.idiomatic: I am old and declining, fearing I will not again see peace; I call to Heaven and knock upon the earth, fast and purify myself for seven days, and respectfully present the sincerity of worry and danger.

sentences.zh: 惟陛下密行臣言，翻然若出聖心警悟者，則人心自悅，天意自回。

translations.literal: If only Your Majesty will secretly act on your servant's words and turn about as if awakened from the sage heart, then hearts will naturally rejoice and Heaven's intent will naturally turn back.
translations.idiomatic: If only Your Majesty will secretly act on my words and turn about as if awakened from the sage heart, then hearts will naturally rejoice and Heaven's intent will naturally turn back.

sentences.zh: 苟不然者，陛下他日雖悔，將何及耶！

translations.literal: If not, though Your Majesty may regret it another day, what will there be time for!
translations.idiomatic: If not, though Your Majesty may regret it another day, what will there be time for!

sentences.zh: 疏入，不報。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted; no response was given.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted; no response was given.

sentences.zh: 坤遂稱疾乞休，中旨許之。

translations.literal: Kun then pleaded illness and requested retirement; an edict from the inner court granted it.
translations.idiomatic: Kun then pleaded illness and requested retirement; an edict from the inner court granted it.

sentences.zh: 於是給事中戴士衡劾坤機深志險，謂石星大誤東事，孫鑛濫殺不辜，坤顧不言，曲為附會，無大臣節。

translations.literal: Thereupon Supervising Secretary Dai Shiheng impeached Kun as deep in scheming and dangerous in intent, saying Shi Xing had greatly erred in eastern affairs and Sun Kuang had indiscriminately killed the innocent; Kun looked on without speaking and twisted matters to support them, lacking the integrity of a grand minister.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Supervising Secretary Dai Shiheng impeached Kun as deep in scheming and dangerous in intent, saying Shi Xing had greatly erred in eastern affairs and Sun Kuang had indiscriminately killed the innocent; Kun looked on without speaking and twisted matters to support them, lacking the integrity of a grand minister.

sentences.zh: 給事中劉道亨言往年孫丕揚劾張位，位疑疏出坤手，故使士衡劾坤。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Liu Daohang said that in former years Sun Piyang impeached Zhang Wei, and Wei suspected the memorial came from Kun's hand, therefore causing Shiheng to impeach Kun.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Liu Daohang said that in former years Sun Piyang impeached Zhang Wei, and Wei suspected the memorial came from Kun's hand, therefore causing Shiheng to impeach Kun.

sentences.zh: 位奏辨。

translations.literal: Wei memorialized in defense.
translations.idiomatic: Wei memorialized in defense.

sentences.zh: 帝以坤既罷，悉置不問。

translations.literal: The Emperor, since Kun had already been dismissed, set everything aside without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, since Kun had already been dismissed, set everything aside without inquiry.

sentences.zh: 初，坤按察山西時，嘗撰《閨範圖說》，內侍購入禁中。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Kun was surveillance commissioner of Shanxi, he had compiled Illustrations and Explanations of Women's Standards, which inner-court attendants purchased and brought into the Forbidden City.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Kun was surveillance commissioner of Shanxi, he had compiled Illustrations and Explanations of Women's Standards, which inner-court attendants purchased and brought into the Forbidden City.

sentences.zh: 鄭貴妃因加十二人，且為制序，屬其伯父承恩重刊之。

translations.literal: Consort Zheng added twelve figures and also wrote a preface, instructing her uncle Chengen to republish it.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Zheng added twelve figures and also wrote a preface, instructing her uncle Chengen to republish it.

sentences.zh: 士衡遂劾坤因承恩進書，結納宮掖，包藏禍心。

translations.literal: Shiheng then impeached Kun for presenting the book through Chengen, forming ties with the inner palace and harboring treacherous intent.
translations.idiomatic: Shiheng then impeached Kun for presenting the book through Chengen, forming ties with the inner palace and harboring treacherous intent.

sentences.zh: 坤持疏力辨。

translations.literal: Kun held a memorial and forcefully argued in his defense.
translations.idiomatic: Kun held a memorial and forcefully argued in his defense.

sentences.zh: 未幾，有妄人為《閨範圖說》跋，名曰《憂危竑議》，略言：「坤撰《閨範》，獨取漢明德後者，後由貴人進中宮，坤以媚鄭貴妃也。

translations.literal: Not long after, a reckless man wrote a postface to Illustrations and Explanations of Women's Standards titled "Anxiety and Danger Broad Discourse," which in summary said: "Kun compiled Women's Standards and took only Empress Mingde of Han—she rose from honored lady to empress of the inner palace; Kun did this to flatter Consort Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, a reckless man wrote a postface to Illustrations and Explanations of Women's Standards titled "Anxiety and Danger Broad Discourse," which in summary said: "Kun compiled Women's Standards and took only Empress Mingde of Han—she rose from honored lady to empress of the inner palace; Kun did this to flatter Consort Zheng.

sentences.zh: 坤疏陳天下憂危，無事不言，獨不及建儲，意自可見。」

translations.literal: In his memorial Kun set forth the realm's anxiety and danger and spoke of everything, yet alone did not touch on establishing the heir—the intent can clearly be seen."
translations.idiomatic: In his memorial Kun set forth the realm's anxiety and danger and spoke of everything, yet alone did not touch on establishing the heir—the intent can clearly be seen."

sentences.zh: 其言絕狂誕，將以害坤。

translations.literal: The words were utterly mad and absurd, intending to harm Kun.
translations.idiomatic: The words were utterly mad and absurd, intending to harm Kun.

sentences.zh: 帝歸罪於士衡等，其事遂寢。

translations.literal: The Emperor placed blame on Shiheng and others, and the matter was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor placed blame on Shiheng and others, and the matter was dropped.

sentences.zh: 坤剛介峭直，留意正學。

translations.literal: Kun was rigid, independent, and steeply upright, and devoted attention to orthodox learning.
translations.idiomatic: Kun was rigid, independent, and steeply upright, and devoted attention to orthodox learning.

sentences.zh: 居家之日，與後進講習。

translations.literal: In the days when he lived at home, he lectured and studied with junior scholars.
translations.idiomatic: In the days when he lived at home, he lectured and studied with junior scholars.

sentences.zh: 所著述，多出新意。

translations.literal: What he wrote and compiled mostly contained fresh ideas.
translations.idiomatic: What he wrote and compiled mostly contained fresh ideas.

sentences.zh: 初，在朝與吏部尚書孫丕揚善。

translations.literal: Earlier, while at court he was on good terms with Minister of Personnel Sun Piyang.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, while at court he was on good terms with Minister of Personnel Sun Piyang.

sentences.zh: 後丕揚復為吏部，屢推坤左都御史未得命，言：「臣以八十老臣保坤，冀臣得親見用坤之效。

translations.literal: Later Piyang again became Minister of Personnel and repeatedly recommended Kun as Left Censor-in-Chief without obtaining approval, saying: "Your servant, an old man of eighty, vouches for Kun, hoping to live to see the effect of employing Kun.
translations.idiomatic: Later Piyang again became Minister of Personnel and repeatedly recommended Kun as Left Censor-in-Chief without obtaining approval, saying: "I, an old man of eighty, vouch for Kun, hoping to live to see the effect of employing Kun.

sentences.zh: 不效，甘坐失舉之罪，死且無憾。」

translations.literal: If it fails, I am willing to sit under the crime of mistaken recommendation and die without regret."
translations.idiomatic: If it fails, I am willing to sit under the crime of mistaken recommendation and die without regret."

sentences.zh: 已，又薦天下三大賢，沈鯉、郭正域，其一即坤。

translations.literal: Later he again recommended the three greatest worthies under Heaven—Shen Li, Guo Zhengyu, one of whom was Kun.
translations.idiomatic: Later he again recommended the three greatest worthies under Heaven—Shen Li, Guo Zhengyu, one of whom was Kun.

sentences.zh: 丕揚前後推薦，疏至二十餘上，帝終不納。

translations.literal: Piyang's recommendations before and after amounted to more than twenty memorials, yet the Emperor ultimately did not accept them.
translations.idiomatic: Piyang's recommendations before and after amounted to more than twenty memorials, yet the Emperor ultimately did not accept them.

sentences.zh: 福王封國河南，賜莊田四萬頃。

translations.literal: The Prince of Fu was enfeoffed in Henan and granted forty thousand qing of estate land.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Fu was enfeoffed in Henan and granted forty thousand qing of estate land.

sentences.zh: 坤在籍，上言：「國初分封親籓二十有四，賜田無至萬頃者。

translations.literal: Kun, while at home, memorialized: "At the founding of the state twenty-four imperial princes were enfeoffed, and granted land never reached ten thousand qing.
translations.idiomatic: Kun, while at home, memorialized: "At the founding of the state twenty-four imperial princes were enfeoffed, and granted land never reached ten thousand qing.

sentences.zh: 河南已封周、趙、伊、徽、鄭、唐、崇、潞八王，若皆取盈四萬，占兩河郡縣且半，幸聖明裁減。」

translations.literal: Henan has already enfeoffed the eight princes of Zhou, Zhao, Yi, Hui, Zheng, Tang, Chong, and Lu; if all take the full forty thousand, they would occupy nearly half the commanderies and districts of the two Henans—may the sage ruler cut and reduce."
translations.idiomatic: Henan has already enfeoffed the eight princes of Zhou, Zhao, Yi, Hui, Zheng, Tang, Chong, and Lu; if all take the full forty thousand, they would occupy nearly half the commanderies and districts of the two Henans—may the sage ruler cut and reduce."

sentences.zh: 復移書執政言之。

translations.literal: He also sent a letter to the chief ministers saying the same.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent a letter to the chief ministers saying the same.

sentences.zh: 會廷臣亦力爭，得減半。

translations.literal: When court officials also strove forcefully, the grant was reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: When court officials also strove forcefully, the grant was reduced by half.

sentences.zh: 卒，天啟初，贈刑部尚書。

translations.literal: He died; at the beginning of Tianqi he was posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He died; at the beginning of Tianqi he was posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 郭正域

translations.literal: Guo Zhengyu
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhengyu

sentences.zh: 郭正域，字美命，江夏人。

translations.literal: Guo Zhengyu, styled Meiming, was a man of Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhengyu, styled Meiming, was a native of Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 萬曆十一年進士。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Wanli he passed the metropolitan examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Wanli he passed the metropolitan examination.

sentences.zh: 選庶起士，授編修，與修撰唐文獻同為皇長子講官。

translations.literal: Selected as a Hanlin bachelor, he was appointed compiler and together with Academician Tang Wenxian served as lecturer to the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Selected as a Hanlin bachelor, he was appointed compiler and together with Academician Tang Wenxian served as lecturer to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 皆三遷至庶子，不離講帷。

translations.literal: Both were promoted three times to tutor and never left the lecture curtain.
translations.idiomatic: Both were promoted three times to tutor and never left the lecture curtain.

sentences.zh: 每講畢，諸內侍出相揖，惟二人不交一言。

translations.literal: After each lecture the inner-court attendants came out and bowed to one another; only these two exchanged not a word.
translations.idiomatic: After each lecture the inner-court attendants came out and bowed to one another; only these two exchanged not a word.

sentences.zh: 出為南京祭酒。

translations.literal: He went out as Chancellor of the National University in Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as Chancellor of the National University in Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 諸生納貲許充貢，正域奏罷之。

translations.literal: Students who paid money were permitted to serve as tribute graduates; Zhengyu memorialized to abolish this.
translations.idiomatic: Students who paid money were permitted to serve as tribute graduates; Zhengyu memorialized to abolish this.

sentences.zh: 李成梁孫以都督就婚魏國徐弘基家，騎過文廟門，學錄李維極執而抶之。

translations.literal: The grandson of Li Chengliang, a military commissioner, went to marry into the household of the Duke of Wei Xu Hongji and rode past the Confucian temple gate; the university recorder Li Weiji seized and flogged him.
translations.idiomatic: The grandson of Li Chengliang, a military commissioner, went to marry into the household of the Duke of Wei Xu Hongji and rode past the Confucian temple gate; the university recorder Li Weiji seized and flogged him.

sentences.zh: 李氏蒼頭數十人蹋邸門，弘基亦至。

translations.literal: Several dozen of the Li family's servants trampled the residence gate, and Hongji also arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Several dozen of the Li family's servants trampled the residence gate, and Hongji also arrived.

sentences.zh: 正域曰：「今天子尚皮弁拜先聖，人臣乃走馬廟門外乎？

translations.literal: Zhengyu said: "Today the Son of Heaven still wears the leather cap to bow to the Sage; can a subject gallop outside the temple gate?
translations.idiomatic: Zhengyu said: "Today the Son of Heaven still wears the leather cap to bow to the Sage; can a subject gallop outside the temple gate?

sentences.zh: 且公侯子弟入學習禮，亦國子生耳，學錄非抶都督也。」

translations.literal: Moreover the sons of dukes and marquises who enter the school to learn ritual are also National University students—the recorder is not flogging a military commissioner."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the sons of dukes and marquises who enter the school to learn ritual are also National University students—the recorder is not flogging a military commissioner."

sentences.zh: 令交相謝而罷。

translations.literal: He ordered them to apologize to each other and the matter ended.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered them to apologize to each other and the matter ended.

sentences.zh: 三十年，征拜詹事，復為東宮講官。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was summoned and appointed Grand Tutor, again serving as lecturer in the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he was summoned and appointed Grand Tutor, again serving as lecturer in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 旋擢禮部右侍郎，掌翰林院。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to Right Vice Minister of Rites and put in charge of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was promoted to Right Vice Minister of Rites and put in charge of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 三十一年三月，尚書馮琦卒，正域還署部事。

translations.literal: In the third month of the thirty-first year Minister Feng Qi died, and Zhengyu returned to administer the ministry's affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the thirty-first year Minister Feng Qi died, and Zhengyu returned to administer the ministry's affairs.

sentences.zh: 夏，廟饗，會日食，正域言：「《禮》，當祭日食，牲未殺，則廢。

translations.literal: In summer, at the temple feast, an eclipse of the sun coincided; Zhengyu said: "According to the Rites, when an eclipse occurs on a day of sacrifice, if the victim has not yet been killed, the rite is abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, at the temple feast, an eclipse of the sun coincided; Zhengyu said: "According to the Rites, when an eclipse occurs on a day of sacrifice, if the victim has not yet been killed, the rite is abandoned.

sentences.zh: 朔旦宜專救日，詰朝享廟。」

translations.literal: On the first day of the month one should devote oneself solely to rescuing the sun, and on the following day perform the temple offering."
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the month one should devote oneself solely to rescuing the sun, and on the following day perform the temple offering."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was followed.
translations.idiomatic: This was followed.

sentences.zh: 方澤陪祀者多托疾。

translations.literal: Many who attended sacrifice at the Square Mound pleaded illness.
translations.idiomatic: Many who attended sacrifice at the Square Mound pleaded illness.

sentences.zh: 正域謂祀事不虔，由上不躬祀所致。

translations.literal: Zhengyu said the sacrificial affairs were not reverent because the sovereign did not personally perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengyu said the sacrificial affairs were not reverent because the sovereign did not personally perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 請下詔飭厲，冬至大祀，上必親行。

translations.literal: He requested an edict of admonition—that at the great sacrifice of the winter solstice the sovereign must personally attend.
translations.idiomatic: He requested an edict of admonition—that at the great sacrifice of the winter solstice the sovereign must personally attend.

sentences.zh: 帝然之，而不能用。

translations.literal: The Emperor agreed but could not implement it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor agreed but could not implement it.

sentences.zh: 初，正域之入館也，沈一貫為教習師。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Zhengyu entered the Academy, Shen Yiguan was his instructor.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Zhengyu entered the Academy, Shen Yiguan was his instructor.

sentences.zh: 後服闋授編修，不執弟子禮，一貫不能無望。

translations.literal: Later, after mourning, he was appointed compiler and did not observe the ritual of pupil to master; Yiguan could not be without resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Later, after mourning, he was appointed compiler and did not observe the ritual of pupil to master; Yiguan could not be without resentment.

sentences.zh: 至是，一貫為首輔，沈鯉次之。

translations.literal: At this time Yiguan was chief grand secretary and Shen Li second.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Yiguan was chief grand secretary and Shen Li second.

sentences.zh: 正域與鯉善，而心薄一貫。

translations.literal: Zhengyu was friendly with Li but inwardly looked down on Yiguan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengyu was friendly with Li but inwardly looked down on Yiguan.

sentences.zh: 會台官上日食占，曰：「日從上食，占為君知佞人用之，以亡其國。」

translations.literal: When censorial officials submitted an eclipse prognostication saying, "The sun is eaten from above; the omen is that the ruler knows flatterers and employs them, thereby destroying his state,
translations.idiomatic: When censorial officials submitted an eclipse prognostication saying, "The sun is eaten from above; the omen is that the ruler knows flatterers and employs them, thereby destroying his state,

sentences.zh: 一貫怒而詈之，正域曰：「宰相憂盛危明，顧不若瞽史邪？」

translations.literal: Yiguan angrily reviled them; Zhengyu said: "A chief minister should worry in prosperity, be wary in peace, and be clear in danger—does he not even match a blind historian?"
translations.idiomatic: Yiguan angrily reviled them; Zhengyu said: "A chief minister should worry in prosperity, be wary in peace, and be clear in danger—does he not even match a blind historian?"

sentences.zh: 一貫聞之怒。

translations.literal: Yiguan heard this and grew angry.
translations.idiomatic: Yiguan heard this and grew angry.

sentences.zh: 兩淮稅監魯保請給關防，兼督江南、浙江織造，鯉持不可，一貫擬予之，正域亦力爭。

translations.literal: Lu Bao, tax supervisor of the two Huai regions, requested an official seal and concurrently to supervise weaving in Jiangnan and Zhejiang; Li held this impossible, Yiguan drafted approval, and Zhengyu also strove forcefully against it.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Bao, tax supervisor of the two Huai regions, requested an official seal and concurrently to supervise weaving in Jiangnan and Zhejiang; Li held this impossible, Yiguan drafted approval, and Zhengyu also strove forcefully against it.

sentences.zh: 秦王以嫡子夭未生，請封其庶長子為世子，屢詔趣議。

translations.literal: The Prince of Qin, his legitimate son having died young with no [new] birth, requested that his eldest son by a concubine be enfeoffed as heir; repeated edicts urged deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Qin, his legitimate son having died young with no [new] birth, requested that his eldest son by a concubine be enfeoffed as heir; repeated edicts urged deliberation.

sentences.zh: 前尚書馮琦持不上，正域亦執不許。

translations.literal: The former Minister Feng Qi withheld submission; Zhengyu also firmly refused permission.
translations.idiomatic: The former Minister Feng Qi withheld submission; Zhengyu also firmly refused permission.

sentences.zh: 王復請封其他子為郡王，又不可。

translations.literal: The prince again requested that another son be enfeoffed as commandery prince—again this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The prince again requested that another son be enfeoffed as commandery prince—again this was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 一貫使大璫以上命脅之，正域榜於門曰：「秦王以中尉進封，庶子當仍中尉，不得為郡王。

translations.literal: Yiguan sent a great eunuch to threaten him with the sovereign's command; Zhengyu posted a notice on the gate saying: "The Prince of Qin was advanced from security-commissioner rank to prince; a son by a concubine should remain at security-commissioner rank and may not be enfeoffed as commandery prince.
translations.idiomatic: Yiguan sent a great eunuch to threaten him with the sovereign's command; Zhengyu posted a notice on the gate saying: "The Prince of Qin was advanced from security-commissioner rank to prince; a son by a concubine should remain at security-commissioner rank and may not be enfeoffed as commandery prince.

sentences.zh: 妃年未五十，庶子亦不得為世子。」

translations.literal: The consort is not yet fifty years old; a son by a concubine also may not become heir."
translations.idiomatic: The consort is not yet fifty years old; a son by a concubine also may not become heir."

sentences.zh: 一貫無以難。

translations.literal: Yiguan had no way to refute this.
translations.idiomatic: Yiguan had no way to refute this.

sentences.zh: 及建議欲奪黃光升、許論、呂本諡，一貫與硃賡皆本同鄉也，曰：「我輩在，誰敢奪者！」

translations.literal: When deliberation arose on stripping the posthumous titles of Huang Guangsheng, Xu Lun, and Lü Ben, Yiguan and Zhu Geng were both natives of Ben's home district and said: "While we are here, who dares strip them!"
translations.idiomatic: When deliberation arose on stripping the posthumous titles of Huang Guangsheng, Xu Lun, and Lü Ben, Yiguan and Zhu Geng were both natives of Ben's home district and said: "While we are here, who dares strip them!"

sentences.zh: 正域援筆判曰：「黃光升當諡，是海瑞當殺也。
